definition.name: Exhibition Stand · internal candidate v1
definition.description: UNAPPROVED CANDIDATE · INTERNAL EVIDENCE PILOT. Human evidence capture only; not an official GTI standard. No conditional rules, skip, external dispatch, procurement, automatic tasks or archive. After all stages, project closure still requires a separately Director-approved per-project document policy, actual Owner completion request and separate Director final decision. Blueprint gti-exhibition-stand revision 1; source 2026-09-29 SHA-256 4d86f90d173a406ad9f3a5ffbba7ce55776b5d209f4bc2a0e4653f299d61b944. Eight source stages retained. Manual dates only; no backward schedule or annual report import. Contractor/organiser records do not verify external approvals. Linked-project references, separate-budget summaries, snags, storage and ratings remain evidence without typed relationships or enforcement. Internal candidate choice: requiredness, bounds, file counts, reviewer routing and fixed gates need business confirmation.

workflow.interpretation: Source sequence retained as configurable evidence stages. Creative work uses existing Universal Tasks; no legacy concept engine. Internal candidate choice: requiredness, bounds, file counts, reviewer routing and fixed gates need business confirmation.

gaps.missing: Detailed requiredness, file limits, reviewer identities where unspecified and pilot completion gates need business confirmation; no official designation process.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: All helper-generated settings are labeled candidate choices. Independent report-file review is narrower than a source-approved report authorization model.

gaps.missing: No fixed organiser milestone enforcement, cross-date constraints or backward scheduling from event dates.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Manually entered DATE fields and planning records; no calculated deadlines or automatic schedule.

gaps.missing: No automatic last-year wrap-up retrieval into Research or verified next-year report reuse.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: An authorized user may upload an eligible previous report manually. Uploads do not establish cross-project provenance or retrieval rights.

gaps.missing: No structured invited-contractor selection, minimum three distinct offers, offer comparison or per-vendor completeness validation.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Record proposed/selected builders, offer summaries and comparison evidence; fixed file counts never mean three distinct offers.

gaps.missing: No CERBER qualification, Director-approved external RFP dispatch, contractual authorization, procurement or vendor communication.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Director reviews internal contractor evidence only. No communication is sent and no actual contract or expenditure is authorized.

gaps.missing: No concept-task-to-stage completion gate or unrestricted revision-cycle enforcement.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Manually create Initial/Final Concept tasks and retain exact reviewed designs; references do not prove all creative work completed.

gaps.missing: No verified organiser submission, identity, approval decision or approval-version binding.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Uploaded submission/approval records are human evidence, not an external approval or automated release.

gaps.missing: No typed stand-to-merchandise/apparel/POSM/catering relationships, separate linked-budget entities or aggregation.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Plain references describe related work only; no foreign keys, inferred access or budget roll-up are created.

gaps.missing: No relational snag list, automatic corrective tasks or unresolved-snag-to-stage blocking adapter.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Create actual General Tasks manually and record references. A snag summary/checklist cannot establish assignments or issue resolution.

gaps.missing: No physical stand/safety certification or bilateral signed stand acceptance.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Independent review of supervision, corrective-action and Acceptance Protocol evidence only; uploads do not certify physical conditions or signatures.

gaps.missing: No typed reusable-element inventory, storage custody, quantities or future-event allocation.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Store dismantling/storage evidence and summary only; no actual inventory reconciliation.

gaps.missing: No three separate Owner/Co-owner/Director ratings for every vendor across quality, timeliness, price and communication, or rating closure gate.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Optional rating-summary evidence preserves the requirement without claiming a generic checklist satisfies it.

gaps.missing: No actual-cost/commitment ledger, source-specific financial visibility/alerts, individual CRM leads or meeting records.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Manual numeric counts and cost-versus-budget report under existing V2 access controls; no accounting, CRM or live event integration.

gaps.missing: No prefilled document/signature lifecycle, legally approved contract guard or automatic large-format/AV file preflight. Document table stage numbers do not match every process purpose.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Manually prepared brief/RFP/contract/protocol files and human File Standard review by purpose. No legal or binary certification.

gaps.missing: Report approval and source automatic archiving cannot replace the approved V2 final-project governance or certify vendor ratings.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: No automatic closure or archive. Separate Director-approved document policy, actual Owner request and distinct Director final decision remain mandatory.

tasker.instructions: Manually create Initial Concept tasks for stand directions and 3D renders; existing independent review applies. No minimum concept count or task-to-stage gate.
Use Final Concept tasks with eligible exact inspiration for revisions/final design and drawings. Organiser approval is separate human evidence, not a Tasker decision or verified external gate.

blueprint.revisionPolicy: Increment blueprint revision for content or policy changes. Keep semantic IDs for unchanged meanings; new meanings need new IDs and a compatibility map. Imported copies are editable and edits are not automatically source-certified. Published versions and runtime pins never change.
